added.name: PPLX Decider v1 (27B)
added.excerpt: PPLX Decider v1 (27B) is Perplexity's multimodal decision model: send application state and typed questions (noul / choice / score) and get back a probability distribution over a fixed set of answers — it returns probabilities, not generated chat text, and produces no free-form output.

added.name: Fledge Alpha
added.excerpt: Fledge Alpha is a free-tier stealth preview reasoning model with text and image input and tool use.

added.name: Strands Decider 2B
added.excerpt: Strands Decider 2B is AWS Strands Labs' small open-weight decision model: send application state and typed questions (noul / choice / score) and get calibrated probabilities back in one forward pass — it returns answers with confidence scores, not generated chat text, and produces no free-form output.

added.name: Pareto 26.10 Preview
added.excerpt: Pareto 26.10 Preview is Unbiased's newer composite model — it blends several language models into one answer, takes text and image input, and returns text over a 1,048,576-token context window (131,072 max completion).
